product_metadata.title: Pure Comfort Queen Size Raised Air Mattress, Blue
features: Raised queen size air mattress creates a portable and inflatable bedding option for guests or a luxurious option for camping
2-in-1 valve enables quick and easy inflation and deflation within minutes; Do not overinflate as seams may burst
Waterproof top is flocked for softness, standard-sized queen sheets will fit perfectly and flocking will keep them in place
Patented bottom construction uses air suction to securely grip floor and prevent movement on hard surfaces
Queen size air mattress measures 74" L x 60" W x 22" H and supports up to 500 lbs.; Includes oversized travel bag and a quick repair kit
description: The Pure Comfort Raised Profile Queen Size Air Mattress is designed to give you and your family the best support and comfort possible. With 22 inches of air and cushion you and your guests will always get the relaxing, refreshing, good night’s sleep you need. This air bed features a patented suction grip bottom, designed to keep your bed in place and prevent slipping on hard surfaces. Pure Comfort’s state of the art coil beam technology adds cushion and support to every part of your body for seamless comfort. The plush, waterproof top is flocked for softness and keeps your sheets place, even for more active sleepers; fits standard queen size sheets. Designed with a 2-in-1 valve the speed of inflation/deflation is greatly increased, providing a faster set up and storage process; includes an oversized travel bag and a quick repair kit. The Pure Comfort Raised Profile Queen Size Air Mattress comes with an ETL certified electric air pump that inflates your bed in minutes; meets all prescribed product safety standards and. This queen sized air mattress measures 74" L x 60" W x 22" H and supports up to 500 lbs.
